Levels recomputed from the whole-run graph (max 7); no cycles; no B supplier, forward ref, or Recorded target; no AC use anywhere.

## Design reconciliation (recorded in notes)

- L6382/L6395 are the two headings of the *same* binding inventory section; the controlling text is HA-29 P13/P14/B5 with the conventions at L5405–5483. Plan-spec agrees on all page data.
- Two proposed deps were removed as unused (ungraded evaluation lemma, ungraded transformation theorem; the graded route proves both directly), and the 2-category/local-smallness claim was sharpened to the locally small subclass the theorem uses. The converse direction of P13 is proved via degreewise transport of the batch-25 tensor lemmas instead of re-deriving the presentation diagram.
